title: Unique Paths
summary: A robot starts in the upper-left cell of an m-by-n grid.

contractDetails.constraints: 1 ≤ m,n ≤ 100. The route count is at most 2000000000.

statement: A robot starts in the upper-left cell of an m-by-n grid. Each move goes one cell right or down. Count the distinct routes to the lower-right cell.

examples.explanation: The sole downward move can be made in any column.
Choose where the two downward moves occur among four moves.
The empty route already reaches the destination.

constraints: 1 ≤ m,n ≤ 100. The route count is at most 2000000000.
hints: Conceptual: A single row or column permits exactly one route.
Directional: Every interior route arrives from above or from the left.
Implementation: Fill the grid in row order. A rolling row can hold the previous-row and current-row counts.
complexityAnalysis: O(mn) time and O(n) extra space.
